prompt: The attached image is a 244x240 px frame from an animated GIF. Rebuild the scene in 3D with three.js. Task (3D, static): write an HTML page that builds the scene from code and renders it so that the view from your reference camera reproduces the image as faithfully as you can: characters, poses, facial expressions, hands, props, background, and colors. A later step will animate your scene, so structure it in named groups. For this static step, render(t) may ignore t. three.js contract: - The harness injects an import map for three.js r187. Import from 'three' and from 'three/addons/'; the only addons available are 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ConvexGeometry.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ParametricFunctions.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ParametricGeometry.js', 'three/addons/geometries/RoundedBoxGeometry.js', 'three/addons/math/ConvexHull.js', 'three/addons/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js'. Use one
html:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Yellow Duck</title>
<style>
  html, body { margin: 0; width: 244px; height: 240px; overflow: hidden; background: #fff; }
  canvas { display: block; width: 244px; height: 240px; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';

const scene = new THREE.Scene();
scene.background = new THREE.Color(0xffffff);

const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ preserveDrawingBuffer: true });
renderer.setPixelRatio(1);
renderer.setSize(244, 240);
renderer.outputColorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

const ref = new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-1.22, 1.22, 1.20, -1.20, 0.05, 60);
ref.position.set(0, 2.18, 9.8);
ref.lookAt(0, 1.20, 0);

const pitch = Math.atan(0.1);
const cosine = Math.cos(pitch);
const sine = Math.sin(pitch);

function point(x, row, z) {
  return new THREE.Vector3((x - 122) / 100, 1.2 + (120 - row) / (100 * cosine) + z * Math.tan(pitch), z);
}

function projectedRow(y, z) {
  return 120 - 100 * ((y - 1.2) * cosine - z * sine);
}

function group(name, parent, worldPosition = new THREE.Vector3()) {
  const node = new THREE.Group();
  node.name = name;
  parent.add(node);
  node.position.copy(parent.worldToLocal(worldPosition.clone()));
  return node;
}

scene.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 1.10));
scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xfffcf0, 0xe5d6bb, 0.63));

function light(name, color, intensity, x, y, z) {
  const lamp = new THREE.DirectionalLight(color, intensity);
  lamp.name = name;
  lamp.position.set(x, y, z);
  lamp.target.position.y = 1.2;
  scene.add(lamp, lamp.target);
}
light('soft key', 0xfff8e7, 1.87, -3.8, 6.4, 7.5);
light('front fill', 0xfff4ea, 0.62, 4.5, 3.0, 6.0);
light('back fill', 0xfff1cb, 1.26, 1.4, 4.9, -5.2);

const ground = new THREE.Mesh(
  new THREE.PlaneGeometry(180, 180),
  new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
    uniforms: {
      paper: { value: new THREE.Color(0xffffff) },
      floor: { value: new THREE.Color(0xd5cdd0) },
      shadow: { value: new THREE.Color(0x967d67) }
    },
    vertexShader: `
      varying vec2 groundPoint;
      void main() {
        vec4 world = modelMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0);
        groundPoint = world.xz;
        gl_Position = projectionMatrix * viewMatrix * world;
      }
    `,
    fragmentShader: `
      uniform vec3 paper;
      uniform vec3 floor;
      uniform vec3 shadow;
      varying vec2 groundPoint;
      void main() {
        float distanceFromDuck = length(groundPoint * vec2(0.91, 1.0));
        float fade = smoothstep(1.85, 5.9, distanceFromDuck);
        vec2 p = (groundPoint - vec2(0.10, -0.08)) / vec2(0.85, 0.62);
        float contact = exp(-dot(p, p) * 1.5) * 0.38;
        gl_FragColor = vec4(mix(mix(floor, paper, fade), shadow, contact), 1.0);
        #include <colorspace_fragment>
      }
    `
  })
);
ground.name = 'pale studio floor';
ground.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
ground.position.y = -0.257;
scene.add(ground);

const duck = group('character-yellow-duck', scene);
const torso = group('torso', duck);
const head = group('head', duck, point(124, 63, -0.021));
const mouth = group('mouth', head, point(124, 44, 0.343));
const eyes = group('eyes', head, point(123, 23, 0.21));
const leftArm = group('arm-image-left', duck, point(71, 140, 0.29));
const rightArm = group('arm-image-right', duck, point(197, 131, 0.27));
const leftHand = group('hand-image-left', leftArm, point(75, 103, 0.45));
const rightHand = group('hand-image-right', rightArm, point(206, 94, 0.42));

const matte = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0xffffff, vertexColors: true });
const smooth = (a, b, x) => THREE.MathUtils.smoothstep(x, a, b);

function ramp(stops) {
  const colors = stops.map(([row, color]) => [row, new THREE.Color(color)]);
  return function sample(row) {
    let i = 1;
    while (i < colors.length - 1 && row > colors[i][0]) i++;
    const [a, low] = colors[i - 1];
    const [b, high] = colors[i];
    return low.clone().lerp(high, THREE.MathUtils.clamp((row - a) / (b - a), 0, 1));
  };
}

function spot(x, y, centerX, centerY, width, height) {
  const u = (x - centerX) / width;
  const v = (y - centerY) / height;
  return Math.exp(-u * u - v * v);
}

// Cross sections are listed as image row, center X, half width,
// center depth in world units, and half depth in hundredths of a unit.
function interpolate(sections, index, component, t) {
  const a = sections[index];
  const b = sections[index + 1];
  const before = sections[Math.max(index - 1, 0)];
  const after = sections[Math.min(index + 2, sections.length - 1)];
  const span = b[0] - a[0];
  const m0 = span * (b[component] - before[component]) / (b[0] - before[0]);
  const m1 = span * (after[component] - a[component]) / (after[0] - a[0]);
  const value = a[component] + t * (
    m0 + t * (3 * (b[component] - a[component]) - 2 * m0 - m1 +
    t * (2 * (a[component] - b[component]) + m0 + m1))
  );
  return THREE.MathUtils.clamp(value, Math.min(a[component], b[component]), Math.max(a[component], b[component]));
}

function loft(sections, paint, profile = () => 1, sides = 96) {
  const rows = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < sections.length - 1; i++) {
    const start = sections[i][0];
    const end = sections[i + 1][0];
    const steps = Math.ceil((end - start) / 1.0);
    for (let j = 0; j < steps; j++) {
      const t = j / steps;
      rows.push([
        THREE.MathUtils.lerp(start, end, t),
        interpolate(sections, i, 1, t),
        interpolate(sections, i, 2, t),
        interpolate(sections, i, 3, t),
        interpolate(sections, i, 4, t)
      ]);
    }
  }
  rows.push(sections[sections.length - 1]);

  const positions = [];
  const colors = [];
  const triangles = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
    const [row, centerX, width, centerZ, depth] = rows[i];
    const y = point(centerX, row, centerZ).y;
    for (let j = 0; j < sides; j++) {
      const angle = 2 * Math.PI * j / sides;
      const front = Math.cos(angle);
      const scale = profile(row, angle);
      const x = centerX + width * Math.sin(angle) * scale;
      const z = centerZ + depth * front * scale / 100;
      positions.push((x - 122) / 100, y, z);
      const c = paint(x, projectedRow(y, z), front, angle, row);
      colors.push(c.r, c.g, c.b);
      if (i < rows.length - 1) {
        const a = i * sides + j;
        const b = i * sides + (j + 1) % sides;
        triangles.push(a, a + sides, b, b, a + sides, b + sides);
      }
    }
  }
  const geometry = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  geometry.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(positions, 3));
  geometry.setIndex(triangles);
  geometry.computeVertexNormals();

  return { rows, positions, colors, normals: geometry.attributes.normal.array, sides };
}

function loftMesh(name, shape, parent, first = 0, last = shape.rows.length - 1) {
  const { sides, rows } = shape;
  const origin = parent.getWorldPosition(new THREE.Vector3());
  const positions = [];
  const normals = [];
  const colors = [];
  const indices = [];

  function copyVertex(row, j, capNormal) {
    const n = (row * sides + j) * 3;
    positions.push(shape.positions[n] - origin.x, shape.positions[n + 1] - origin.y, shape.positions[n + 2] - origin.z);
    if (capNormal === undefined) {
      normals.push(shape.normals[n], shape.normals[n + 1], shape.normals[n + 2]);
    } else {
      normals.push(0, capNormal, 0);
    }
    colors.push(shape.colors[n], shape.colors[n + 1], shape.colors[n + 2]);
  }

  for (let i = first; i <= last; i++) {
    for (let j = 0; j < sides; j++) {
      copyVertex(i, j);
      if (i < last) {
        const a = (i - first) * sides + j;
        const b = (i - first) * sides + (j + 1) % sides;
        indices.push(a, a + sides, b, b, a + sides, b + sides);
      }
    }
  }

  for (const [row, up] of [[first, 1], [last, -1]]) {
    const base = positions.length / 3;
    for (let j = 0; j < sides; j++) copyVertex(row, j, up);
    const [y, x, , z] = rows[row];
    const center = point(x, y, z).sub(origin);
    positions.push(center.x, center.y, center.z);
    normals.push(0, up, 0);
    const n = row * sides * 3;
    colors.push(shape.colors[n], shape.colors[n + 1], shape.colors[n + 2]);
    for (let j = 0; j < sides; j++) {
      const a = base + j;
      const b = base + (j + 1) % sides;
      if (up > 0) indices.push(base + sides, a, b);
      else indices.push(base + sides, b, a);
    }
  }

  const geometry = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  geometry.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(positions, 3));
  geometry.setAttribute('normal', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(normals, 3));
  geometry.setAttribute('color', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(colors, 3));
  geometry.setIndex(indices);
  const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, matte);
  mesh.name = name;
  parent.add(mesh);
}

const yellow = ramp([
  [-5, 0xffe769], [10, 0xedda53], [29, 0xf1d754], [48, 0xffcc50],
  [72, 0xffcc56], [91, 0xf7bf54], [116, 0xefb54f], [150, 0xe4b352],
  [179, 0xe0b663], [205, 0xd4a757], [229, 0xc9a04e], [265, 0xb98a38]
]);
const cream = ramp([
  [76, 0xffd67d], [103, 0xffdb9e], [127, 0xffdcb3], [158, 0xffdbb2],
  [182, 0xf4cca0], [208, 0xe9bc83], [236, 0xd2a65c]
]);
const eyeHalo = new THREE.Color(0x857935);
const beakWash = new THREE.Color(0xf09b3e);
const wingShadow = new THREE.Color(0xa7752d);
const crownLight = new THREE.Color(0xffed72);

function bodyColor(x, y, front) {
  const color = yellow(y);
  const facing = smooth(0.05, 0.69, front);
  const patch = Math.hypot((x - 129) / 68, (y - 145) / 72);
  color.lerp(cream(y), (1 - smooth(0.41, 1.21, patch)) * facing);
  color.lerp(crownLight, 0.55 * facing * spot(x, y, 121, 5, 33, 18));
  color.lerp(beakWash, 0.65 * facing * spot(x, y, 124, 53, 26, 17));
  color.lerp(eyeHalo, 0.61 * facing * spot(x, y, 102, 25, 8.5, 9));
  color.lerp(eyeHalo, 0.65 * facing * spot(x, y, 145, 21, 8.3, 8.6));
  color.lerp(wingShadow, 0.52 * smooth(-0.15, 0.4, front) * (
    spot(x, y, 65, 140, 16, 24) + spot(x, y, 190, 113, 12, 29)
  ));
  return color;
}

const body = loft([
  [-5.2, 123, 0.16, -0.055, 0.16],
  [-3, 123, 14, -0.055, 11], [0, 122.5, 22, -0.054, 17],
  [5, 122, 28, -0.053, 22], [12, 122, 33, -0.048, 27],
  [22, 122, 37, -0.043, 31], [33, 122.5, 41, -0.038, 35],
  [46, 123.3, 47, -0.030, 40], [56, 124, 53, -0.024, 45],
  [63, 124.5, 57, -0.021, 48], [75, 125, 64, -0.014, 53],
  [94, 125, 70, -0.011, 58], [117, 125.3, 76.4, -0.011, 64.5],
  [142, 125.5, 81, -0.012, 70], [170, 125.5, 87, -0.017, 76],
  [196, 125.4, 90.6, -0.022, 78], [210, 125.1, 90.4, -0.026, 77.5],
  [227, 124.9, 87.4, -0.032, 74], [242, 124.6, 82.3, -0.037, 67],
  [253, 124.5, 71, -0.04, 56], [260, 124.5, 53, -0.04, 39],
  [263.2, 124.5, 29, -0.04, 21], [263.8, 124.5, 0.18, -0.04, 0.18]
], bodyColor, (row, angle) => 1 + 0.028 * Math.cos(angle) + 0.012 * Math.sin(3 * angle));

const neck = body.rows.findIndex(row => row[0] === 63);
loftMesh('rounded head and neck', body, head, 0, neck);
loftMesh('pear-shaped body', body, torso, neck);

const billColors = ramp([
  [33, 0xffdc65], [37, 0xffdc70], [42, 0xf1b953], [48, 0xe9a045],
  [55, 0xeca34a], [62, 0xf1ac4b], [68, 0xf4b548]
]);
const lipShade = new THREE.Color(0xd58a39);
const bill = loft([
  [33, 123.5, 0.12, 0.336, 0.12], [35.2, 123.5, 8.5, 0.334, 2.5],
  [38, 123.8, 14.6, 0.338, 4.9], [42, 124, 18.5, 0.342, 6.3],
  [48, 124.8, 19.4, 0.346, 6.8], [54, 125.3, 17.1, 0.350, 6.4],
  [60, 125.5, 12.8, 0.354, 5.6], [64, 125.5, 7.8, 0.361, 3.6],
  [67, 125.6, 0.12, 0.365, 0.12]
], (x, y, front) => {
  const smile = 42.0 - 0.005 * (x - 124) ** 2;
  return billColors(y).lerp(lipShade, 0.22 * Math.max(0, front) * spot(x, y, 124, smile, 16, 2.35));
}, (row, angle) => 1 + 0.07 * Math.cos(angle), 72);
loftMesh('short rounded bill', bill, mouth);

function makeEye(name, x, y, z, turn, tilt, width, height) {
  const eye = group(name, eyes, point(x, y, z));
  eye.rotation.y = turn;
  eye.rotation.z = tilt;
  const geometry = new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 36, 24);
  const vertices = geometry.attributes.position;
  const colorArray = [];
  const center = new THREE.Color(0x171a0e);
  const edge = new THREE.Color(0x474729);
  for (let i = 0; i < vertices.count; i++) {
    const shade = 1 - smooth(0.15, 0.91, vertices.getZ(i));
    const c = center.clone().lerp(edge, shade * 0.87);
    colorArray.push(c.r, c.g, c.b);
  }
  geometry.setAttribute('color', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(colorArray, 3));
  const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, matte);
  mesh.name = 'dark eye';
  mesh.scale.set(width, height, 0.033);
  eye.add(mesh);
}

makeEye('eye-image-left', 103.4, 25.6, 0.236, -0.40, -0.13, 0.045, 0.055);
makeEye('eye-image-right', 144.0, 20.8, 0.208, 0.44, 0.12, 0.047, 0.056);

const wingColors = ramp([
  [75, 0xeaba49], [93, 0xf4c55a], [109, 0xf8bd51], [127, 0xeeb04b],
  [142, 0xe5a443], [154, 0xcd923b], [165, 0xb88536]
]);
const wingLight = new THREE.Color(0xffd16b);
const wingWarm = new THREE.Color(0xe7a644);

function wingPaint(side) {
  return (x, y, front) => {
    const c = wingColors(y);
    const left = side === -1;
    c.lerp(wingLight, 0.49 * spot(x, y, left ? 48 : 215, left ? 111 : 104, 15, 27));
    c.lerp(wingWarm, 0.34 * Math.max(0, front) * spot(x, y, left ? 63 : 214, left ? 136 : 131, 19, 20));
    c.lerp(wingShadow, 0.28 * spot(x, y, left ? 83 : 193, left ? 145 : 116, 11, 25));
    return c;
  };
}

const leftWing = loft([
  [85, 70, 0.14, 0.29, 0.14], [92, 69, 10.4, 0.32, 9.5],
  [101, 67, 16.6, 0.36, 14.9], [111, 63.5, 20.8, 0.40, 19.5],
  [124, 61, 23.2, 0.425, 22], [137, 61, 22.0, 0.415, 19.5],
  [148, 62, 17.5, 0.382, 16], [156, 63, 12, 0.345, 11],
  [162, 65, 5.4, 0.299, 5.7], [164, 66, 0.14, 0.265, 0.14]
], wingPaint(-1));
loftMesh('raised left wing', leftWing, leftArm);

const rightWing = loft([
  [75, 207, 0.14, 0.263, 0.14], [83, 207.7, 8.5, 0.302, 8.4],
  [93, 208.2, 13, 0.34, 13.1], [106, 209.1, 17.2, 0.373, 17.5],
  [119, 211.4, 19.6, 0.393, 19.7], [130, 213.7, 18.3, 0.381, 18.2],
  [141, 212.3, 14.8, 0.347, 14.4], [148, 209.7, 9, 0.305, 9.2],
  [152, 207, 3.4, 0.27, 4.4], [153, 205.3, 0.14, 0.25, 0.14]
], wingPaint(1));
loftMesh('raised right wing', rightWing, rightArm);

const tipDark = new THREE.Color(0x3e3820);
const tipOlive = new THREE.Color(0x807044);
const leftTipColors = ramp([
  [71, 0x81764b], [77, 0x615634], [86, 0x51452a], [97, 0x55482b],
  [106, 0x6c552c], [112, 0x816335], [115, 0xa37b3b]
]);
const rightTipColors = ramp([
  [60, 0x736649], [67, 0x5d5339], [76, 0x47402b], [85, 0x51452b],
  [94, 0x60512e], [102, 0x7e6234], [106, 0x99733a]
]);

const leftTip = loft([
  [71.3, 67.8, 0.1, 0.371, 0.12], [73.6, 66.7, 5.0, 0.385, 4.7],
  [78.5, 66.0, 10.1, 0.409, 8.8], [85.5, 68.2, 14.6, 0.435, 11.8],
  [93.4, 70.4, 17.1, 0.463, 13.1], [100.5, 72.8, 15.7, 0.476, 11.5],
  [106.0, 76.2, 12.2, 0.477, 9.5], [110.2, 79.4, 8.4, 0.469, 6.0],
  [112.3, 81.0, 0.12, 0.45, 0.13]
], (x, y, front) => {
  const c = leftTipColors(y);
  c.lerp(tipOlive, 0.36 * spot(x, y, 60, 83, 7, 12));
  c.lerp(tipDark, 0.42 * Math.max(0, front) * spot(x, y, 71, 92, 7, 11));
  return c;
}, (row, angle) => 1 + 0.043 * Math.sin(3 * angle + row * 0.09), 72);
loftMesh('dark left wing tip', leftTip, leftHand);

const rightTip = loft([
  [60.5, 213.2, 0.12, 0.346, 0.12], [62.7, 213.7, 3.2, 0.368, 3.6],
  [67.8, 214.6, 6.8, 0.397, 6.8], [74.5, 215.2, 10.3, 0.425, 9.5],
  [82.1, 212.2, 13.8, 0.448, 11.5], [89.4, 209.4, 13.2, 0.458, 11.7],
  [96.3, 206.4, 10.6, 0.451, 9.6], [101.3, 204.4, 6.1, 0.436, 6.2],
  [104, 203.1, 0.12, 0.422, 0.12]
], (x, y, front) => {
  const c = rightTipColors(y);
  c.lerp(tipDark, 0.48 * Math.max(0, front) * spot(x, y, 217, 75, 7.5, 12));
  c.lerp(tipOlive, 0.30 * spot(x, y, 203, 85, 7.5, 8));
  return c;
}, (row, angle) => 1 + 0.049 * Math.sin(3 * angle - row * 0.115), 72);
loftMesh('dark right wing tip', rightTip, rightHand);

function render(t) {
  renderer.render(scene, ref);
}

render(0);
window.nwb = { scene, renderer, cameras: { ref }, characters: [duck], render, ready: true };
</script>
</body>
